主要内容: KENTUCKY BANCSHARES INC /KY/ reported a non-binding advisory vote on executive compensation, with 2,946,944 votes for, 235,229 against, and 52,566 abstentions. The company also held a vote on the frequency of shareholder votes for executive compensation, with 2,828,638 votes for, 216,289 against, and 105,232 abstentions. The votes were conducted on June 16, 2020.
